sql:
with o as (
 select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) s,
        case when strategy='Fmmsell10' then 'B' else 'A' end p, kalshi_order_id k
   from live_orders
  where action='buy' and side='no' and kalshi_order_id is not null
    and ((strategy in ('mmsell10','mmsell10a','mmsell10b','Lmmsell10','Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Emmsell10')
          and created_at >= '2026-07-26' and created_at < '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z')
      or (strategy='Fmmsell10' and created_at >= '2026-09-07T02:03:36Z'))
), f as (select distinct kalshi_order_id k from fills where kalshi_order_id is not null)
select s, sum((p='A')::int) a_ord, sum((p='A' and f.k is not null)::int) a_fill,
       sum((p='B')::int) b_ord, sum((p='B' and f.k is not null)::int) b_fill
  from o left join f using (k) group by s
 order by sum((f.k is not null)::int) desc
